title: Full-Stack Dev & System Architecture Prompts
description: Production-tested system architecture and engineering prompts specifically calibrated for Claude 3.7 Sonnet, GPT-4o, and DeepSeek-V3. Covers Next.js App Router performance, high-throughput microservice boundaries, resilient database schema modeling, distributed caching, and automated end-to-end testing.
deliverables: High-Performance Next.js 15 App Router & Server Action Architecture Matrix
Prisma & MongoDB High-Throughput Sharding & Indexing Playbook
Microservice Event Bus & Distributed Caching Implementation Directives
Enterprise Security Hardening, OWASP Compliance & API Gateways
features: Strict JSON Schema validation for automated AI code generation
Optimized context-window prompt engineering for zero hallucination
Direct compatibility with Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and ChatGPT
Lifetime minor version updates and quarterly prompt refreshes
Commercial single-developer & agency project distribution rights

modules.title: Section 1: Next.js App Router & Server Component Topologies
modules.description: Deep architectural patterns for Server vs Client Component boundaries, streaming SSR with Suspense, and resilient optimistic mutation patterns.

modules.title: Section 2: Database Schema Modeling & High-Throughput Indexing
modules.description: Prisma ORM and MongoDB compound indexing schemas, aggregation pipeline optimization, and multi-region read replicas.

modules.title: Section 3: Microservice Resiliency & Event-Driven Patterns
modules.description: Idempotent webhook handlers, message queues (Redis/Kafka), dead-letter queue architectures, and distributed locking.

modules.title: Section 4: Defensive TypeScript & Automated Test Generation
modules.description: Strict type-safe API contracts with Zod, Jest unit test suites, and Playwright end-to-end critical journey test templates.

modules.title: Section 5: Enterprise Security & Rate Limiting Hardening
modules.description: HMAC signature verification, token bucket rate limiters, session protection, and OWASP top 10 prevention rules.
